1. Engagement Scope

The scope of this engagement encompasses a systematic evaluation of Joplin Kinsella Advisory's compensation administration practices against regulatory benchmarks established under applicable law. Field work was conducted between 2004-07-23 and 2004-09-28, with data collection spanning 205 employee records across 10 reporting units in the Sports Betting & Gaming sector.

2. Methodology

The review of {org}'s HIPAA compliance included a security risk analysis based on the NIST SP 800-30 framework, covering {n} systems that create, receive, maintain, or transmit electronic PHI.

4. Detailed Findings
CIR-4401-001LOWMONITORING
Observation

Salary range disclosure missing from 20% of job postings in jurisdictions requiring it

Corrective Action Required

The designated management official at each of the 10 establishments shall personally certify the OSHA 300A summary by the February 1st deadline annually.

Management Response

Management agrees with the assessment. A new hire has been approved to serve as the dedicated process owner for this compliance area, with an expected start date of 2004-07-23.

Owner: Policy Research Specialist • Due: 2004-08-28
CIR-7233-002HIGHDEFERRED
Observation

COBRA election notices for 205 qualifying events sent 20% later than the statutory 14-day deadline

Corrective Action Required

Mandatory ADA interactive process training shall be assigned to all managers. The HR team will implement a centralized case management system to document all accommodation requests and outcomes.

Management Response

The finding is acknowledged. This issue is part of a larger, previously identified process deficiency that is being addressed through a company-wide transformation project (Project Veritas). We request this finding be tracked as part of that larger initiative.

Owner: Associate, Corporate Development • Due: 2004-09-28
CIR-8370-003LOWDEFERRED
Observation

Variable pay accrual methodology inconsistent with IRC §401(k) (qualified cash or deferred arrangements); California Equal Pay Act (Labor Code §1197.5) disclosure requirements

Corrective Action Required

A project will be initiated to map all job titles to the new job architecture and establish compliant pay ranges for all roles, with a priority on roles based in Colorado.

Management Response

We agree with the finding. A request for proposal (RFP) has been issued to select a vendor to assist with the implementation of the corrective action. The vendor selection is expected to be complete by 2004-07-23.

Owner: Director of Internal Investigations • Due: 2004-08-28
CIR-7856-004MEDIUMDEFERRED
Observation

ADA interactive process not documented for 205 accommodation requests reviewed during the period

Corrective Action Required

Update the 401(k) plan's investment policy statement (IPS) to reflect current fiduciary best practices and document the committee's review of investment performance against the IPS on a quarterly basis.

Management Response

Management disputes the risk classification of this finding. While acknowledging the documentation gap, Joplin Kinsella Advisory believes the underlying practices are compliant with applicable requirements. A formal response memorandum has been filed with the engagement team under separate cover.

Owner: Manager of Project Delivery • Due: 2004-09-28
CIR-7731-005MEDIUMIN PROGRESS
Observation

OSHA 300A summary not certified by a company executive for 10 establishments

Corrective Action Required

All severance and release agreements for employees aged 40 and over must be reviewed by legal counsel to ensure compliance with all OWBPA requirements, including consideration periods.

Management Response

Joplin Kinsella Advisory accepts this finding. A corrective action plan has been developed and assigned to the designated owner. Implementation is targeted for completion by the due date indicated. Progress will be reported to ACPWB on a monthly basis until formal closure.

Owner: Director of External Communications • Due: 2004-09-28
